what: A fresh working copy with none of its usual tooling installed yet had every one of its checks fail to even start, and that was silently scored the same as a real failure of the change itself.
rule: An environment-setup step meant to prepare a fresh working copy should run on every attempt, not only when something happened to look like it needed it; and a check that never even started is not the same thing as a real failure.
fix: Enforcement: a setup step now runs before checks on every attempt; a setup step that cannot even start is now called out plainly instead of being scored as a real failure of the change. Regression coverage is in `tests/field-lessons-batch-p.test.mjs`.
